readings.summary: Setting SuppressSourceGeneration to true must disable only generated-source emission, while the MessagePack analyzer continues to analyze user code and report all applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics as it did in version 3.1.0.
readings.code_difference: The analyzer's registration or execution must no longer be skipped, directly or indirectly, because SuppressSourceGeneration is true; only source generation is skipped, and behavior when the property is unset or false remains unchanged.

readings.summary: When SuppressSourceGeneration is true, only source generation is suppressed; the MessagePack analyzers must continue reporting all applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics as they did in 3.1.0.
readings.code_difference: Analyzer execution and diagnostic reporting must remain active under SuppressSourceGeneration = true, while generated source remains absent; configurations with the property false or unset retain their existing analyzer and source-generation behavior.

readings.summary: `SuppressSourceGeneration = true` must suppress only generated source output, while the analyzer continues to report all applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics as it did in 3.1.0; unset or false behavior remains unchanged.
readings.code_difference: Analyzer registration and diagnostic analysis must remain active when source generation is suppressed, rather than being disabled together with the generator, and suppression must still prevent source-generation output.
